messages:
morgan: Quick flag — during today's canary the auto-fallback flipped because of 1.2% 502s over 30s window. latency was steady ~120ms. why did error trigger override?
esteban: Current rule is error_rate>0.01 over 30s OR p95>800ms. error triggers are global; doesn't check error classes so 502 counts same as ENOTFOUND.
rachel: That's noisy. We should add classification: only surface server-side 5xx except 502 when upstream=rate_limit header? also set a 'burst' suppression window.
sophia: UX ask: console should show explicit "fallback cause" with the raw signal breakdown and a small sample of requests. Operators need quick triage.
morgan: A few constraints: can't slow decision loop >200ms. So we need simple heuristics in evaluator not heavy sampling.
esteban: Proposal (pseudo-yaml):
```yaml
fallback_policy:
  error_triggers:
    - class: server_5xx
      threshold: 0.015
      window: 60s
      suppress_if_qps_drop_pct: 50
    - class: client_4xx
      threshold: 0.05
      ignore: true
  latency_triggers:
    p95_ms: 800
    sample_window: 30s
  decision_cooldown: 120s
  audit_log: sample_rate: 1%
```
morgan: love that. audit_log.sample_rate must be adjustable per-customer (privacy + cost). Also need an audit payload shape in API: {rollout_id, decision_ts, reason_tags, sample_ids}
esteban: Telemetry names: `rollout.fallback.count`, `rollout.fallback.reason:{class}`, `rollout.fallback.cooldown_ms`, `rollout.fallback.sampled_request_id`
policy-evaluator-bot: policy-evaluator: executed fallback for rollout r-4021, reason=server_5xx, error_rate=0.012, window=30s
rachel: For console: add an expand arrow with 3 example traces and the metric sparkline for last 5m. Clickable trace opens trace-ui with auto-filter applied.
sophia: Small UI caveat: don't show raw request bodies inline. Only show ids with button "request details" that requires extra auth.
morgan: I'll prototype the console card. rachel, can you do the mockup? esteban, will you update evaluator to add reason tags and suppress logic?
rachel: Yep — I'll drop mockups in #design-review by 5pm :+1:
esteban: I'll start a branch for suppress-if-qps-drop and add unit tests. tagging infra to expose sample API.
morgan: Filing infra ticket INF-9423 for sample API & storage. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9423
rachel: ok, followups: (1) define default sample_rate per plan, (2) add opt-out for customers, (3) document audit retention.
morgan: agreed. thanks all :pray:
